supporting_observations.claim: From 13:33:47 through 13:48:48 UTC, FILE-MAP-01 repeatedly attempted network logons for svc-docsync at roughly one-minute intervals. The failures report SubStatus=0xc000006a, consistent with an incorrect password, and identify FILE-MAP-01 as the workstation; corresponding DC records also show failed Kerberos preauthentication or credential validation.

The supplied change calendar says svc-docsync's password was scheduled for rotation at 13:30 UTC, and the supplied inventory says its FILE-MAP-01 job runs and re-authenticates every minute. Those facts provide a plausible benign explanation for the repeated wrong-password attempts after the rotation, but the records do not establish that this is what happened.

At 13:21:41 UTC, WS-AHASSAN-01 recorded an explicit-credentials event targeting svc-docsync on DC-MAP-01, with ProcessName shown as C:\Program Files\Commvault\ContentStore\Base\GxCVD.exe and SubjectUserName=SYSTEM. This is an additional use of the alerted account that is not explained by the repeated FILE-MAP-01 failures; the event alone does not establish whether authentication succeeded or whether the activity was authorized.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records end at 13:48:48 UTC, so they do not cover the remainder of the requested 13:20–14:20 UTC window.
The supplied evidence contains no corresponding successful-logon records or outcome for the explicit-credentials event.

The records do not show whether the scheduled password rotation was completed, when the DocSync job configuration was updated, or what process initiated the repeated attempts beyond the reported LSASS process.
No process validation, service/job logs, or network context is provided to establish whether the Commvault executable on WS-AHASSAN-01 is legitimate.
claims_not_established: Whether the password rotation occurred at 13:30 UTC and whether the DocSync job continued using the old password.
Whether the explicit-credentials event on WS-AHASSAN-01 was authorized or related to a legitimate administrative or application action.
Whether svc-docsync had any successful or otherwise unobserved authentication activity during the full review window.
Whether the reported Commvault executable and its use of svc-docsync are legitimate in this environment.
additional_evidence_needed: Confirm the actual password-rotation time and the time the DocSync job's stored credentials were updated; review the job's execution and authentication logs.
Validate the 13:21 explicit-credentials event with the administrator and inspect WS-AHASSAN-01 process, service, and file-signature telemetry for the reported executable.
Collect domain-controller and relevant host authentication records for the full 13:20–14:20 UTC window, including successful logons and account-use events.
